petrodemon.name: {first}{second}, {epithet}
body: that holds a shape only for as long as it is angry
stacked in lobes that boil against each other
heavy enough to press its own prints into stone
that runs uphill when nobody is looking at it
cold to the touch and lit from somewhere inside
wearing an oil film that turns colours no oil turns
that pools, gathers itself, and stands back up
seamed with the sludge of an entire field
grafts: Limbs it never grew are set into it at every angle, still twitching.
Wings, jaws and machine parts sit half-drowned in the surface.
Bones of a dozen species surface and sink as it moves.
It wears the anatomy of everything the well took down with it.
Antlers, mandibles and a piston arm work out of time with one another.
Whatever it swallowed is still trying to walk away.
Grafted parts open and close on nothing, remembering their old bodies.
The heap bristles with claws, stalks and one very patient eye.
origin: It came up a capped well and has been coming up ever since.
It was a reserve on a balance sheet before it was a creature.
Nothing drilled it; it drilled itself.
The field it rose from is still listed as producing.
It answers to a barrel price and nothing else.
It has been under the ground longer than there has been a ground.
Something down there is refining, and this is what it exports.
It is what a lease looks like when it is finally called in.
